label: TP
reason: User-controlled input from HTTP header flows through URL decode, then combines with TESTFILES_DIR to construct file paths without validation allowing path traversal attacks. The parameter also flows through HashMap operations and reaches HTML output sinks. While ESAPI encoder is applied to HTML output, the path construction vulnerability is real and exploitable.

evidence.note: User input from Header flows through decode and constructs file path without validation
Path traversal vulnerability - fileName combines user input without validation before passing to Paths.get
HTML output sink receives user-controlled file name
